title: mintchocolatechip
description: It's not vanilla. It's not chocolate. It's Mint Chocolate Chip!
body:
It's not Vanilla, it's not Chocolate. It's Mint Chocolate Chip! 

- Includes over 300 custom picked mods for a flow that fits vanilla yet still feels solidly modded!
- Has a large focus on exploration, technology, and overhauled game progression, but includes much needed performance mods, QoL enhancements, and small changes to sound and lighting to become more immersive.
- This modpack is a carefully chose kitchensink. It includes something for everyone, but doesn't feel overly bloated!
- Some of the most prominent mods included are:  World Generation Mods ([Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith), [WWOO](https://modrinth.com/mod/wwoo), [Incendium](https://modrinth.com/datapack/incendium), [Enderscape](https://modrinth.com/mod/enderscape)), Structure Generation Mods ([YUNG's](https://modrinth.com/user/YUNGNICKYOUNG) mods, [Dungeons and Taverns](https://modrinth.com/user/NovaWostra) mods), Building Mods ([Handcrafted](https://modrinth.com/mod/handcrafted), [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped)), [Ecliptic Seasons](https://ecliptic-seasons.readthedocs.io/en/latest/en/), [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight), [The Undergarden](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-undergarden), [The Aether](https://modrinth.com/mod/aether), [Bosses' Rise](https://modrinth.com/mod/bossesrise), [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), and many more!

This modpack is in early development. Because of this, I recommend making a backup of your world and other important folders between updates, and to look over the version changelog before installing. 
You may notice some inconsistencies or bugs during your playthrough, but we are working hard to improve with every update, ultimately ensuring smooth, enjoyable gameplay.
